 Rapid City’s Festival of Lights Parade set for Nov. 28 
 Download the KOTA News App. By Mary Francis Witte Published : Oct. 22, 2026 at 7:30 PM CDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google RAPID CITY, S.D. (KOTA) - Downtown Rapid City will light up for the holiday season Nov. 28 as the annual Festival of Lights Parade returns with decorated floats, holiday music and local groups.
 The parade is scheduled for Saturday, Nov. 28, continuing a community tradition that helps usher in the Christmas season.
 Businesses, nonprofits and other community organizations can also join the celebration. Registration packets are available at festivaloflightsrc.com .
 Organizers are expected to release more details as the event approaches.
